name: Current robot geometry and assembly
description: Native assembly and every referenced mesh of the simulated arm: base, links, modified fingers, wrist camera and bracket. Preserve the relative directories when parsing. The two arms share this geometry; current camera/base calibration is provided separately.

name: Base component
description: Single solid base component in STEP AP203 format. A component reference, not a complete arm assembly. Standard finger shapes do not represent the modified simulated fingers; use the physical reference for installed geometry. Not a native editable CAD project.

name: End assembly component
description: End component with three solid bodies in STEP AP203 format. A component reference, not a complete arm assembly. Standard finger shapes do not represent the modified simulated fingers; use the physical reference for installed geometry. Not a native editable CAD project.
